name: Blob Fighter
text: Add 3 Combat Ally: Draw a card. Either kill it before it signals the hive or run. There are other choices, but none you'll live through.

name: Battle Pod
text: Add 4 Combat You may scrap a card in the trade row. Ally: Add 2 Combat

name: Trade Pod
text: Add 3 Trade Ally: Add 2 Combat The loading and offloading process is efficient, but disgusting.

name: Blob Wheel
text: Add 1 Combat Scrap: Add 3 Trade

name: Ram
text: Add 5 Combat Ally: Add 2 Combat Scrap: Add 3 Trade

name: Blob Destroyer
text: Add 6 Combat Ally: Destroy target base and/or scrap a card in the trade row. When this monstrous ship shows up on a colony's sensors, they know the end is near...

name: The Hive
text: Add 3 Combat Ally: Draw a card

name: Battle Blob
text: Add 8 Combat Ally: Draw a card. Scrap: Add 4 Combat

name: Blob Carrier
text:
Add 7 Combat Ally: Acquire any ship without paying its cost and put it on top of your deck. "Is that... a whale?"
- HMS Defender, final transmission.

name: Mothership
text: Add 6 Combat Draw a card. Ally: Draw a card.

name: Blob World
text: Add 5 Combat OR Draw a card for each Blob card that you've played this turn.

name: Trade Bot
text: Add 1 Trade You may scrap a card in your hand or discard pile. Ally: Add 2 Combat

name: Missile Bot
text: Add 2 Combat You may scrap a card in your hand or discard pile. Ally: Add 2 Combat

name: Battle Station
text: Scrap: Add 5 Combat

name: Supply Bot
text: Add 2 Trade You may scrap a card in your hand or discard pile. Ally: Add 2 Combat

name: Patrol Mech
text: Add 3 Trade OR Add 5 Combat Ally: You may scrap a card in your hand or discard pile. With the Blobs an ever present danger, even the cult's cargo carrying mechs bristle with firepower.

name: Stealth Needle
text: Copy another ship you've played this turn. Stealth Needle has that ship's faction in addition to Machine Cult. The Needle's ability to mimic other ships represents the pinnacle of Cult technology.

name: Battle Mech
text: Add 4 Combat You may scrap a card in your hand or discard pile. Ally: Draw a card.

name: Mech World
text: Mech World counts as an ally for all factions. The man-made planet is a galactic center for open source tech.

name: Junkyard
text: Scrap a card in your hand or discard pile. The machine Cult's first commandment: "Thou shalt not waste tech."

name: Missile Mech
text: Add 6 Combat You may destroy target base. Ally: Draw a card

name: Machine Base
text: Draw a card, then scrap a card from your hand. This high-tech city is like a beehive: it looks chaotic but vital work is being done efficiently at a frenetic pace.

name: Brain World
text: Scrap up to two cards from your hand and/or discard pile. Draw a card for each card scrapped this way. The Machine Cult built these supercomputing space stations to run every aspect of their society. Now they worship them as gods.

name: Imperial Fighter
text: Add 2 Combat Target opponent discards a card. Ally: Add 2 Combat

name: Corvette
text: Add 1 Combat Draw a card. Ally: Add 2 Combat

name: Imperial Frigate
text: Add 4 Combat Target opponent discards a card. Ally: Add 2 Combat Scrap: Draw a card

name: Survey Ship
text: Add 1 Trade Draw a card. Scrap: Target opponent discards a card.

name: Recycling Station
text: Add 1 Trade OR Discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.

name: Space Station
text: Add 2 Combat Ally: Add 2 Combat Scrap: Add 4 Trade

name: War World
text: Add 3 Combat Ally: Add 4 Combat

name: Battlecruiser
text: Add 5 Combat Draw a card. Ally: Target opponent discards a card. Scrap: Draw a card. You may destroy target base.

name: Royal Redoubt
text: Add 3 Combat Ally: Target opponent discards a card.

name: Dreadnaught
text: Add 7 Combat Draw a card. Scrap: Add 5 Combat

name: Fleet HQ
text: All of your ships get "Add 1 Combat" When an imperial fleet goes into battle, it's usually coordinated from afar by one of these mobile command centers.

name: Federation Shuttle
text: Add 2 Trade Ally: Add 4 Authority "Fast? This baby doesn't just haul cargo. She hauls..."

name: Cutter
text:
Add 4 Authority Add 2 Trade Ally: Add 4 Combat "Built for cargo, armed for conflict. Versatility for an unpredictable universe."
- Premier Aerospace Cargo Enterprises

name: Embassy Yacht
text: Add 3 Authority Add 2 Trade If you have two or more bases in play, draw two cards War should always be a last resort, it's bad for the bottom line.

name: Freighter
text: Add 4 Trade Ally: You may put the next ship you acquire this turn on top of your deck. This class of mammoth cargo ships is one of the keys to the federation's vast trade-based wealth.

name: Defense Center
text: Add 3 Authority OR Add 2 Combat Ally: Add 2 Combat

name: Trade Escort
text: Add 4 Authority Add 4 Combat Ally: Draw a card. The heavily-armored Escort class was the Federation's first response to the Blob threat.

text: Add 5 Combat Draw a card. Ally: Add 5 Authority

text: Add 3 Trade Scrap: Draw a card. You may destroy target base.

text: Add 2 Trade You may put the next ship you acquire this turn on top of your deck. Ally: Draw a card.
